tagline: Digital Transformation and Sovereignty. Trusted Partner.
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'Geschäftsvolumen' (revenue volume) is the primary growth indicator for Bechtle, reflecting both organic demand and the impact of strategic acquisitions across Europe, making it the key driver of its trajectory in a sustained digital transformation context.

kpis.name: Revenue Volume
kpis.explanation: Total sales realized, including the effects of acquisitions.
kpis.description: Revenue volume over 9 months reached 5.94 billion euros, up 4.7%, with strong momentum in the third quarter.
kpis.signal: Clear growth in Q3, driven by international performance.

kpis.name: Organic Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue volume growth excluding acquisition effects.
kpis.description: Organic growth reached +6.2% in Q3 2025, driven by increased demand in digital transformation projects.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth despite challenging environment.

kpis.name: International Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue volume generated outside Germany.
kpis.description: International revenue reached 909 million euros in Q3, up 17%, supported by acquisitions and demand in European countries.

kpis.name: Earnings Before Tax
kpis.description: EBT reached 202.6 million euros over 9 months, down 17.1%, but showing slight improvement in Q3 (+2.4%).
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure but stabilizing in Q3.

kpis.name: Operating Cashflow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cashflow in Q3 reached 124.9 million euros, down compared to an exceptional quarter in the prior year.
kpis.signal: Result in line with expectations despite decline.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Headcount reached 16,300 employees in Q3 2025, up 4.4%, primarily driven by acquisition integrations.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 4.22 billion euros in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.81 billion euros in latest year

kpis.name: Contribution of Acquisitions to Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue volume generated by recently acquired companies (Nuovamacut and ITAM Solutions).
kpis.description: Acquisitions Nuovamacut (63 million euros) and ITAM Solutions (4.4 million euros) contributed 67.4 million euros to revenue volume in 2025.
kpis.signal: Direct impact of acquisitions on growth.

kpis.name: Launch of Bechtle Index of Sovereignty
kpis.explanation: New software tool to measure clients' digital sovereignty.
kpis.description: The Bechtle Index of Sovereignty will be launched in Q1 2026, offering a structured support model for public and private sector clients, with assessment included to evaluate digital maturity and IT architecture resilience.

risks.title: Increased competition in the European IT market
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in the context of IT market consolidation, with language affirming intensified competitive pressure. Trend is stable, but risk weight is high due to persistent market fragmentation.

risks.title: Dependency on NIS-2 cybersecurity regulation
risks.score_rationale: Text explicitly cites NIS-2 entry into force in 2025 in Germany, with language emphasizing legal obligation. Trend is upward, and the risk is strategic for the Security segment.

risks.title: Increasing complexity of IT infrastructure linked to AI
risks.score_rationale: Risk is clearly identified with strong language on increased complexity. It is in constant rise and central to the services business, weighing on required skills.

risks.title: Risks related to Windows 10 end of support
risks.score_rationale: Precise dated event (October 2025), mentioned as an investment catalyst. Factual language, upward trend temporarily, significant impact on hardware sales.

risks.title: Margin pressure linked to hardware/services mix
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in the context of gross margin fluctuations. Cautious language, stable trend, but recurring during periods of strong hardware growth.

risks.title: Challenges in recruiting and training IT talent
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes the importance of talent training and development. Strategic language, stable trend, but critical for the growth model dependent on human skills.

risks.title: Acceleration of consolidation in the IT market
risks.score_rationale: Risk is described as a structural trend with language affirming post-Covid acceleration. Upward trend, high weight on M&A strategy and competitive position.

risks.title: Dependency on recovery of German public sector investments
risks.score_rationale: Text links sales recovery to revival of public sector investments. Conditional language, upward but uncertain trend, moderate but significant sector impact.

ai_positioning.summary: Bechtle adopts an integrator posture regarding AI, embedding intelligent capabilities into its digital transformation solutions, without positioning as a proprietary technology leader. The emphasis is on sovereignty, security, and client support.
evidence: Development of Bechtle Index of Sovereignty to assess clients' digital maturity
Acquisition of specialized partners (e.g., Dassault Systèmes SOLIDWORKS via Nuovamacut, ITAM Solutions) to strengthen software offerings
Positioning on resilience and sustainability, linked to European regulatory expectations and Net-Zero objectives validated by SBTi
